mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS patient_id, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS patient_name, COUNT(DISTINCT tp.id) FILTER (WHERE tp.status = 'ACTIVE') AS active_plans, COUNT(DISTINCT tp.id) FILTER (WHERE tp.status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_plans, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.id) AS total_sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.id) FILTER (WHERE ts.status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.id) FILTER (WHERE ts.status = 'CANCELLED') AS cancelled_sessions, COUNT(el.id) AS total_exercises_logged, COUNT(el.id) FILTER (WHERE el.completion_status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_exercises, CASE WHEN COUNT(el.id) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE ROUND( COUNT(el.id) FILTER (WHERE el.completion_status = 'COMPLETED') * 100.0 / COUNT(el.id), 2) END AS completion_rate, MODE() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ts.overall_performance) AS avg_performance FROM patients p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN therapy_plans tp ON tp.patient_id = p.id AND tp.deleted = false LEFT JOIN therapy_sessions ts ON ts.patient_id = p.id AND ts.deleted = false LEFT JOIN exercise_logs el ON el.session_id = ts.id AND el.deleted = false WHERE p.id = #{patientId} AND p.deleted = false GROUP BY p.id, u.first_name, u.last_name

SELECT d.id AS doctor_id, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS doctor_name, d.specialization AS specialization, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) AS total_appointments, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_appointments, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'CANCELLED') AS cancelled_appointments, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 'NO_SHOW') AS no_show_appointments, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.id) AS total_sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.id) FILTER (WHERE ts.status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT asmt.id) AS total_assessments, COUNT(DISTINCT tp.id) FILTER (WHERE tp.status = 'ACTIVE') AS total_active_plans FROM doctors d JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id LEFT JOIN appointments a ON a.doctor_id = d.id AND a.deleted = false LEFT JOIN therapy_sessions ts ON ts.doctor_id = d.id AND ts.deleted = false LEFT JOIN assessments asmt ON asmt.doctor_id = d.id AND asmt.deleted = false LEFT JOIN therapy_plans tp ON tp.doctor_id = d.id AND tp.deleted = false WHERE d.id = #{doctorId} AND d.deleted = false GROUP BY d.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, d.specialization
